<div class="card-body">
'''Demotion''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">降格</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費し、帝国軍に配備する。ただし、ダース・ベイダー、パルパタイン皇帝、ストームトルーパーを除く。そのカードは戦闘力が−2され、カードルールを使えなくなる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍において、失敗の罰は非常に厳しい。士官のほとんどが、ダース・ベイダーの処罰を受けるよりは、いっそ降格を望む。</span>

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Demotion.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on an Imperial, except [[Darth Vader]], [[Emperor Palpatine]], or [[Stormtrooper]]. That card's power is reduced by 2, and it can no longer use its card rules.

'''Lore:''' In the Imperial military, punishment for failure is extremely severe. Most officers would rather be demoted than receive punishment from [[Darth Vader]].

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the disabled text “card rules,” where the English says “game text.” Its lore says most officers prefer demotion, compared with “Many officers” in the English printing.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-printing">[[:File:Premiere-L-demotion-decipher-archive.gif|Demotion English printed face]].</ref>

<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Demotion]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].
